description.value: Sal y Limón is a Vancouver-born Mexican restaurant founded by four food enthusiasts drawing on family recipes from Manzanillo, Mexico, serving tacos, tortas, burritos, and other street food favourites. The Fraser Street location is one of three across Metro Vancouver and positions itself as a welcoming, family-friendly spot with a vibrant atmosphere. Catering, gift cards, and both pick-up and delivery ordering are available.
